name: @aily-project/board-walnutpi_serial
description: Independent WalnutPi Linux board for Python Blockly over a user-selected SERIAL-A shell. Uses CPython on Debian, not the CyberCAM K230 CanMV USBDBG path.
description_en: Independent WalnutPi Linux board for Python Blockly over a user-selected SERIAL-A shell. Uses CPython on Debian, not the CyberCAM K230 CanMV USBDBG path.
